en_title: GTA 6 Gets Officially Licensed Trading Cards Based on In-Game Collectibles
cn_title: 《GTA 6》将推出以游戏内收藏品为原型的官方授权集换式卡牌
opus_summary: Rockstar与Panini America合作，依据《GTA 6》游戏内收藏品推出官方授权体育收藏卡，计划于今年12月发售。卡片采用Panini的体育卡体系，并加入Vice City专属配色；售价尚未公布，实体卡的具体数量也尚不明确。

paragraphs.en: The hunt for GTA 6 trading cards is leaving the virtual confines of Leonida — Rockstar is teaming up with Panini America to bring the in-game collectibles to life.
paragraphs.cn: 搜寻《GTA 6》集换式卡牌的活动将走出虚拟的Leonida——Rockstar正与Panini America合作，将游戏内的收藏品带到现实中。

paragraphs.en: The officially licensed GTA 6: Sports Trading Card Collection is based on Panini’s standard sports card system, featuring rare-numbered cards and team color parallels. The GTA collection adds Vice City-specific Silver, Pink, Teal, and Light Blue parallels to the standard slate of Legend Bronze, Silver, and Gold.
paragraphs.cn: 获得官方授权的《GTA 6: Sports Trading Card Collection》以Panini的标准体育卡牌体系为基础，包括稀有编号卡和球队配色平行卡。该《GTA》系列在标准的传奇青铜、白银和黄金款式之外，还加入了罪恶都市专属的银色、粉色、蓝绿色和浅蓝色平行卡。

paragraphs.en: The collectible company has revealed images of several cards planned for the collaboration, which is set to launch this December.
paragraphs.cn: 这家收藏品公司公布了此次合作计划推出的数张卡牌图片，该系列定于今年12月上市。

paragraphs.en: The Panini Group is an Italian-based collectible company that’s become quite the household name for sports card fans. Panini America is the official collectible partner for leagues like the WNBA, NASCAR, and FIFA, just to name a few.
paragraphs.cn: Panini Group是一家总部位于意大利的收藏品公司，在体育卡牌爱好者中可谓家喻户晓。Panini America是WNBA、NASCAR和FIFA等赛事组织的官方收藏品合作伙伴，这只是其中几个例子。

paragraphs.en: GTA 6 cards will be released in four-pack boxes, each of which, on average, come with two Rookies, one Retro, one Illustrated, and four Special Silvers. There’s no word on pricing, but hobby boxes currently listed on Panini’s site start at $30 and go up to over $700.
paragraphs.cn: 《GTA 6》卡牌将以每盒四包的形式发售，每盒平均包含两张新秀卡、一张复古卡、一张插画卡和四张特别银卡。目前尚未公布价格，但Panini网站上现有的收藏盒售价从30美元起，最高超过700美元。

paragraphs.en: Panini’s card images, shown above, feature a collection of fictional athletes from Vice City’s sports teams. Not all of the featured athletes are entirely fake — for instance, Tyreek Hill, ex-wide receiver for the Miami Dolphins, serves as the voice and likeness for the Vice City Manatees’ Maleek Rivers.
paragraphs.cn: 上方展示的Panini卡牌图片中，出现了一些来自罪恶都市各支体育队伍的虚构运动员。但这些运动员并非全是虚构的——例如，Miami Dolphins前外接手Tyreek Hill为Vice City Manatees的Maleek Rivers提供了配音和形象原型。

paragraphs.en: GTA 6 features a total of 480 trading cards across 16 individual sets, and we don't know exactly how many Panini is planning to turn into real cardboard. The sports-focused collectible company is less likely to adapt the collectible cards featuring other GTA 6 characters like Mandy and Vicki , but social media users can hope.
paragraphs.cn: 《GTA 6》中共有16套、总计480张集换式卡牌，我们并不清楚Panini究竟计划将其中多少张制成实体纸卡。这家专注于体育的收藏品公司不太可能改编印有Mandy和Vicki等其他《GTA 6》角色的收藏卡，但社交媒体用户仍可以抱有希望。

paragraphs.en: GTA 6 was officially the biggest entertainment launch of all time, and PlayStation just released a fresh batch of jaw-dropping player data . We considered the game a masterpiece in our 10/10 review , with Luke Reilly calling it "the single most impressive video game I have ever played."
paragraphs.cn: 《GTA 6》正式成为有史以来规模最大的娱乐产品首发，PlayStation刚刚公布了新一批令人瞠目结舌的玩家数据。我们在给出10分满分的评测中认为这款游戏是一部杰作，Luke Reilly称其为「我玩过的最令人印象深刻的一款电子游戏」。

paragraphs.en: Rockstar has gone all out on bringing the already very realistic Vice City to life , and a lot of the action has been happening in the world of sports. Rockstar took over Kaseya Center on the day of GTA 6's launch, with the Miami Heat donning Vice City jerseys for their game against the Milwaukee Bucks.
paragraphs.cn: Rockstar全力将本就十分写实的罪恶都市带到现实中，其中许多活动都发生在体育界。《GTA 6》发售当天，Rockstar接管了Kaseya Center，Miami Heat在对阵Milwaukee Bucks的比赛中身穿罪恶都市球衣。

paragraphs.en: Just getting started in GTA 6 or wondering what to do next? Check out the Official Grand Theft Auto 6 guide right here on IGN. If you're still getting your bearings, discover GTA's new systems with the Beginner's Guide - 67 Tips and Tricks , or get all the details on the first chapters with the Chapter 1 Guide and Tips , Chapter 2 Guide and Tips , and Chapter 3 Guide and Tips . If you're already driving all around Leonida and want to know everything there is to find and do, see the Leonida interactive map .
paragraphs.cn: 刚刚开始玩《GTA 6》，或是不知道接下来该做什么？来IGN查看《GTA 6》官方指南。如果你还在熟悉游戏，可以通过新手指南——67条提示与技巧了解《GTA》的新系统，或通过第1章指南与提示、第2章指南与提示以及第3章指南与提示了解前几章的所有细节。如果你已经开车走遍Leonida，想知道所有可以发现的内容和可以做的事，请查看Leonida互动地图。
